{"items":[
{"title":"German Election Study, 1972 (Politbarometer)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0072","justification":"This dataset provides information on government, political systems, and organizations in Germany during the 1970s, specifically around the federal election of 1972."},
{"title":"German Election Study, 1976 (Politbarometer)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0082","justification":"Contains data relevant to political systems and government organizations in Germany in the mid-1970s, covering the 1976 federal election."},
{"title":"Political Attitudes, Political Participation and Societal Integration: Germany 1973","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0827","justification":"Addresses government and political organizations with a focus on political attitudes and participation in Germany during 1973."},
{"title":"German Society and Politics (ALLBUS Pilot Study 1973)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0450","justification":"Features survey data on German political systems, organizations, and societal attitudes in the early 1970s."},
{"title":"Political Attitudes and Behavior in the Federal Republic (1978)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0819","justification":"Studies public opinion, government, and political organizations in Germany in the late 1970s."},
{"title":"Political Culture in Germany (1973)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0827","justification":"Explores political culture, governmental structures, and organizational dynamics in Germany during 1973."},
{"title":"Political Attitudes, Participation and Engagement in the Federal Republic (1977)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0853","justification":"Dataset focuses on political participation, attitudes, and government involvement in Germany throughout the 1970s."},
{"title":"German Domestic Politics (1975)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0824","justification":"Documents major characteristics of German political systems and governmental organizations in 1975."},
{"title":"Parliamentary Election Study Germany, September 1976","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0840","justification":"Election study casts light on the functioning and structure of government and political systems in Germany during the 1970s."},
{"title":"German Election Study, 1979 (Politbarometer)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1286","justification":"Provides data about the political system and government in Germany at the end of the 1970s with regard to elections and organizations."}
]}
